But, with that said just real short video you may not be able to reach eBay's customer service call centers. I don't know the ETA on that if Brian or somebody from the team text me from the executive team text me or corporate and tells me an ETA or if they're just playing it by ear I would imagine they probably don't know a solid ETA you're gonna have to submit your emails and your messages or direct chat through eBay and try to work it out that way hopefully eBay has has an updated statement on how they're going to handle customer service because i didn't see any messages about the call centers being closed if somebody got that message or received it i missed it and please provide that to me because that would be awesome but i will try to get word from them later today with an update i'll put it on my social medias facebook instagram twitter and hopefully they can give me some sort of ETA, but I'm gonna guess, like a lot of other places, they probably really don't know.
